# pdns_zone_tsig_key (Resource)

Attaches a TSIG key to a zone. A key can be attached to many zones and a zone can have many keys; use exactly one `pdns_zone_tsig_key` per zone and key pair, and enable one or more purposes on it.

`dnsupdate` only takes effect when the PowerDNS server runs with `dnsupdate=yes`; the source addresses allowed to send updates are controlled by the `allow-dnsupdate-from` setting (or the `ALLOW-DNSUPDATE-FROM` zone metadata).

**Concurrency:** PowerDNS stores the TSIG keys of a zone as one list per purpose and has no atomic add or remove, so every change rewrites the whole list. Changes within one run are serialized. Across parallel runs, each change is re-read, retried on conflict and re-checked after one second. This is not a guarantee: to rule out lost or reappearing entries, serialize applies that touch the same zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pdns_tsig_key" "tenant_a" {
  name = "tenant-a"
  key  = var.tenant_a_tsig_secret
}

resource "pdns_tsig_key" "tenant_b" {
  name = "tenant-b"
  key  = var.tenant_b_tsig_secret
}

# One key attached to several zones: tenant-a may send dynamic updates to
# both zones and transfer (AXFR) example.com.
resource "pdns_zone_tsig_key" "tenant_a_example_com" {
  zone        = "example.com."
  tsig_key_id = pdns_tsig_key.tenant_a.id
  dnsupdate   = true
  axfr        = true
}

resource "pdns_zone_tsig_key" "tenant_a_example_org" {
  zone        = "example.org."
  tsig_key_id = pdns_tsig_key.tenant_a.id
  dnsupdate   = true
}

# Several keys on one zone.
resource "pdns_zone_tsig_key" "tenant_b_example_com" {
  zone        = "example.com."
  tsig_key_id = pdns_tsig_key.tenant_b.id
  dnsupdate   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tsig_key_id` (String) ID of the TSIG key, usually `pdns_tsig_key.<name>.id`.
- `zone` (String) Name of the zone to attach the key to. Must end with a dot `.`.

### Optional

- `axfr` (Boolean) Allow zone transfers (AXFR) of the zone signed with this key (`master_tsig_key_ids` / `TSIG-ALLOW-AXFR`). Defaults to `false`.
- `dnsupdate` (Boolean) Allow the key to perform RFC2136 dynamic updates on the zone (`TSIG-ALLOW-DNSUPDATE` metadata). Defaults to `false`. PowerDNS only requires a signature while at least one key is allowed: once no key of the zone has `dnsupdate`, updates from addresses permitted by `allow-dnsupdate-from` are accepted unsigned.
- `secondary` (Boolean) Use the key when this server transfers the zone from its primary, for `Slave`/secondary zones (`slave_tsig_key_ids` / `AXFR-MASTER-TSIG`). Defaults to `false`. PowerDNS allows only one secondary key per zone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the attachment in the form `<zone>/<tsig_key_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Attachments are imported by `<zone>/<tsig_key_id>`.
terraform import pdns_zone_tsig_key.tenant_a_example_com example.com./tenant-a.
```
